# What the system said of a drive, read on GitHub's Windows machines by GetDriveTypeW (the kind) and QueryDosDeviceW
# (the device's first name), each line as read (the probe branch cf233f5 and 50baa9d; x64 and ARM64). Nothing is
# changed; no user's name is in these lines. Format: LETTER <tab> WHAT IT WAS <tab> KIND <tab> DEVICE'S NAME, or
# `not read: error N` where the device's name was not read.
#
# windows-latest (x64)
C:	the system's disk	3	\Device\HarddiskVolume3
D:	a second disk of the machine	3	\Device\HarddiskVolume4
R:	a letter given to a folder (subst R: C:\ProgramData)	3	\??\C:\ProgramData
R:	a letter given to a folder (subst R: "C:\Program Files\RaqibFieldDrive")	3	\??\C:\Program Files\RaqibFieldDrive
R:	a letter given to Program Files (subst R: "C:\Program Files")	3	\??\C:\Program Files
V:	a disk image made for the run, NTFS	3	\Device\HarddiskVolume5
V:	a disk image made for the run, FAT32	3	\Device\HarddiskVolume6
Q:	a letter that is not there	1	not read: error 2
#
# windows-11-arm (ARM64)
C:	the system's disk	3	\Device\HarddiskVolume4
D:	a letter that is not there	1	not read: error 2
R:	a letter given to a folder (subst R: C:\ProgramData)	3	\??\C:\ProgramData
V:	a disk image made for the run, NTFS	3	\Device\HarddiskVolume5
V:	a disk image made for the run, FAT32	3	\Device\HarddiskVolume6
Q:	a letter that is not there	1	not read: error 2
#
# Every disk's volume read so: \Device\HarddiskVolume and a number, and nothing after it. Not read on any machine: a
# network drive, a removable disk, a disc, a RAM disk; a letter whose device's name is a volume's followed by a
# folder's path; a volume of another kind of disk (dynamic, a storage pool).
